quest.title: Good Hunter Express
quest.description: The Good Hunter has a special order that needs sending out...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other matters to settle right now.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Well, okay. I'll see who else I can get to take this commission.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: That would be great, thank you!

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Make sure you stay safe. <color=#00E1FFFF>Try not to get attacked by anything in the ruins, and remember not to run too fast</color>, or the dish might fall out.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Please hurry, this dish won't taste good if it gets cold.

talks.objective: Deliver the food to Hardworking Silio

dialogues.speaker: Hardworking Silio
dialogues.text: Great! This meal should give me enough energy to finally get out of this blasted place.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I heard that someone placed a custom order...

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: That's right. Silio ordered another serving of Mondstadt Grilled Fish today before heading to Stormterror's Lair. Could you help us and deliver this to him real quick?

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: This serving of Mondstadt Grilled Fish <color=#00E1FFFF>can't come into contact with any strange elements</color>, or it might end up tasting funny.
